tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
A startup raised 34 million dollars to help security teams keep up with threats from artificial intelligence. Confirmed by Insider: Mave scales artificial intelligence agents for cybersecurity, with OpenAI helping find a critical website vulnerability.
PHP vulnerabilities caused internet outages, and artificial intelligence accelerates exploitation of outdated code. Confirmed by The Guardian: prepare for more website shutdowns in the age of artificial intelligence, but human inaction is the real culprit.
Schneider Electric, NVIDIA and HPE launch edge-based Industrial artificial intelligence Agents for process industries. Reported by Data Centre Magazine: Schneider Electric, NVIDIA and HPE debut Industrial artificial intelligence Agents.
Bill Gates warns artificial intelligence is the most dangerous thing ever and urges urgent action. Confirmed by The Verge: Bill Gates thinks artificial intelligence could make us live like the Amish.
Katie Haun discusses artificial intelligence safety and insider threats on Squawk Box. Confirmed by CNBC: Katie Haun on artificial intelligence safety concerns, rise of insider threats and liability debate.
Free every hour.
